static_traits.name: Chen Jin
static_traits.family_status: 与丈夫同住于乡村地区
static_traits.social_status: 有几位朋友可进行日常交流，但not yet向朋友谈及其负性思维；与丈夫的关系因其负性思维与反应出现紧张
static_traits.medical_history: without显著躯体疾病；without既往心理问题和治疗史
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰、思路连贯，能自我Reflection与配合，情绪体验可被识do not与表达，语气中性略显Anxiety

basic_info.main_problem: 倾向忽视积极、聚焦负面并将个do notnot如意泛化为整体失败；如为丈夫做晚餐时若其中一道甜点not合口味，便把整餐评价为“灾难”。Retired后该模式更突出，导致对做饭与各类活动产生Anxiety与回避。
basic_info.core_demands: 'I want to find a way to stop these negative thoughts from occupying the joy of life; I hope to improve my mood and my relationship with my husband.'
growth_experiences: 近几年逐渐出现并Reinforcement的负性思维模式：在事件中忽视积极、聚焦负面并贴上整体失败标签；Retired后由于希望与丈夫多相处、感觉自己需要在生活各方面表现出色，该模式更为显著。由此在烹饪与社交活动中出现对失败的Fear, anxiety与回避，影响情绪与关系满意度。

core_beliefs: Only by excelling in all aspects do I have value / deserve recognition
一旦犯错，我就是失败者

special_situations.event: 为丈夫准备了一顿晚餐，他喜欢大部分菜品，但甜点not合口味
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果某个环节出了问题，就说明整件事失败，证明I am not good enough
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids cooking again; over-focuses on their own mistakes; tries to suppress disappointment with 'think of the positive side' but with limited effect
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 整个晚餐都是灾难；我又失败了

special_situations.event: 与丈夫互动时对方对某个细节not yet明确表达称赞（反应平淡/沉默）
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果他have not明确称赞，就说明他not喜欢，说明我做得not好
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 过度关注他人的细微反应并据此评价自己；为避免被negate而减少尝试
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他not说话就是not喜欢；我做得not够好

special_situations.event: Before attending or preparing for social activities, worries in advance about possible small mistakes
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 只要有一个环节出错，就会毁掉整个活动并被他人negate
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 提前Anxiety、回避参加活动以避免失败
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 只要有一点not顺，整个活动就完了

special_situations.event: Retired后有更多时间反复琢磨日常互动与细节
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果not能在新生活中处处表现优秀，就说明I have no value
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: not断回想负面细节、忽略积极反馈以逼自己改进
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我做得还not够好；我not配享受Retired生活

core_conflict.wish: Longing to be recognized by and close to a significant other (the husband), obtaining affirmation and a sense of value in daily life
core_conflict.fear: 害怕失败被negate、被批评或让对方失望，从而破坏关系
defense_goal: 通过追求完美来避免被negate
通过回避可能失败的活动来降低Anxiety与自责

object_relations.self_representation: 苛求完美、害怕失败的“并not够好”的自我
object_relations.object_representation: 潜在的评判者（沉默或反应平淡即被解读为negate）

manifestations: Retired后角色与时间结构变化，试图以“在各方面都要做得出色”来维系价值感
一旦出现小失误即negate整段经历，主观上感到努力“have not意义”
outcomes: 对活动与社交的乐趣下降

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: Internalizes 'must perform excellently in every aspect' as a rigid standard, demanding of self
以全或without标准评价一顿饭的成败
Internalizes others' feedback (such as whether the husband praises) as the core basis for measuring self-worth

positive_force: Willing to seek professional help and actively cooperate, willing to try behavioral experiments
能识do not并表达自身的自动化思维与情绪体验
Has a certain degree of social support (a few friends to talk with)
There are positive moments in interactions with the husband (such as most dishes being recognized)
negative_force: 完美主义与全或without思维倾向明显
negate积极与心理过滤，过度关注负面细节
对他人反应的读心与对外部认可的依赖
对失败的强烈恐惧导致Avoids cooking与活动
Retired后时间增多引发的过度反刍与自我评估

target_behavior.behavior: 在烹饪与日常活动中的Anxiety与回避
antecedent: 在准备做饭或活动前担心可能出现的小失误
在完成后获得或感知到一点负面反馈（如甜点not合口味）
target_behavior.core_reason: 对失败与被negate的恐惧，加之全或without思维与过度概括，导致将个do not差错等同整体失败
target_behavior.function: 逃避潜在的失败与负性评价，以暂时降低Anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: 减少参与喜爱的活动，Decreased enjoyment of life；与丈夫Relationship tension

target_behavior.behavior: 将个do notnot如意贴上“整体失败/灾难”的评价（言语或内心自评）
antecedent: 某个环节not yet达Anticipation或对方反应平淡/沉默
社交或与丈夫互动后的自我回顾与反刍
target_behavior.core_reason: 内化的高标准与外部认可取向，伴随negate积极与心理过滤
target_behavior.function: 通过严苛自评与控制感来防止not yet来错误（表面上的Self-protection）
target_behavior.consequence: Low mood与挫败感增加，进一步加剧Anxiety与回避
